task.title: Respond to an Unexpected Duo Push
task.shortdesc: Deny and report a Duo Push request you didn't start.

taskbody.context: Do this when you receive a Duo Push notification on your phone that you didn't start. An unexpected request usually means someone else knows your password and is trying to sign in to your account.

step.cmd: Open the Duo Mobile app and select Deny.

note.p: Never approve a request you didn't start.

step.cmd: Contact the NC State OIT Help Desk.
step.info: For help, contact the NC State Help Desk through the IT Service Portal or call 919.515.HELP (4357).

taskbody.result: The sign-in attempt is denied and reported, and your new password keeps the other person out of your account.
